segments.normalizedSource: ```swift extension VerticalAlignment { /// A custom alignment for image titles. private struct ImageTitleAlignment: AlignmentID { static func defaultValue(in context: ViewDimensions) -> CGFloat { // Default to bottom alignment if no guides are set. context[VerticalAlignment.bottom] } } /// A guide for aligning titles. static let imageTitleAlignmentGuide = VerticalAlignment( ImageTitleAlignment.self ) } ```
